name: @qed2/desktop
description: QED2 local-first Electron node for macOS, Windows and Linux
author: Tang Xiaoyi

scripts.build: pnpm icons:generate && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:main
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.package: pnpm runtime:prepare && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.unsigned.yml --dir
scripts.dist: pnpm runtime:prepare && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.unsigned.yml
scripts.dist:signed: pnpm runtime:prepare && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.release:signed: pnpm runtime:prepare && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
